name: Gui la Londe
source:
"Meet me in the rose garden."

Those words are the beginning of Marion's journey to untangle the enigma that is the chevalier Gui la Londe. How is it possible for one man to so perfectly embody the essence of gentlemanly grace? Is he really on a secret mission for the Crown? And most vexingly, why in the shadows has he had himself appointed as Marion's chief retainer? She'll need to step carefully if she wants to learn the truth, but it could be difficult when that icy gaze of his turns to fire.

Strengths: Grace, persuasion, extreme natural talent
Flaws: ???

Likes: Roses, courtly manners, free will, meritocracy
Dislikes: Laziness, determinism, the feudal system
